tasks.title: Timeline of the Atom
tasks.performanceStandard: Make a creative representation of the historical development of the atom or the chemical element in a timeline
tasks.description: Create a creative, historically accurate timeline of the development of atomic theory — from Democritus to Schrödinger — showing how each model built on or replaced the previous one.
tasks.deliverable: A creative timeline (poster, digital infographic, or physical display) covering at least 6 atomic models.

criteria.name: Accuracy
criteria.description: All historical dates, scientist names, and model names are correct.

levels.excellent: All information is factually accurate; dates and names correct.
levels.satisfactory: Minor inaccuracies do not affect overall understanding.
levels.needsImprovement: Multiple factual errors; scientists or dates are mixed up.

criteria.name: Completeness
criteria.description: Includes at least 6 atomic models from Democritus to Schrödinger.

levels.excellent: Includes 6+ models with full descriptions of each.
levels.needsImprovement: Fewer than 5 models or missing descriptions.

levels.satisfactory: Neat and organized; some creative elements.
levels.needsImprovement: Plain, disorganized, or copied from online sources.

criteria.name: Scientific Understanding
criteria.description: Shows understanding of how each model improved upon the previous one.

levels.excellent: Clear narrative showing progression from each model to the next.

criteria.name: Presentation
criteria.description: Neat, legible, and appropriate for the audience.

levels.satisfactory: Mostly neat; some minor legibility issues.
levels.needsImprovement: Messy; difficult to read or follow.

grading.note: The Performance Task contributes 20% of the quarterly grade; the written quiz on pt1.html is a supplementary check.
